title: Fed Governor Waller Sees December Rate Increase as Likely, Weighs Half-Point Move
summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said he is leaning toward a December interest-rate increase and would consider a half-percentage-point move if inflation runs hotter than forecast. October CPI rose 0.4% headline and 0.3% core, each 0.1 percentage point above the Dow Jones consensus, while traders fully priced a quarter-point \(0.25 percentage point\) December increase and 12.5% odds of a half-point move.
